(NYSE American: EXOD) (“Exodus” or the “Company”), a leading self-custodial finance and payments platform, today announced October 2026 operating metrics in connection with its Digital Asset and Payment Processing services.


“October reflected steady activity across our payments business, with monthly active cards increasing approximately 6% from September. On the wallet side, monthly active users remained steady at 1.4 million,” said James Gernetzke, CFO of Exodus. “We continue to focus on expanding our payments capabilities and lowering ongoing costs to support profitable growth.”


**Digital Asset Services**
Exchange provider processed volume was $372.1 million for the month of October 2026 compared with $402.7 million exchange provider processed volume in September 2026. XO Swap partners accounted for 24% of October volume, compared to 26% in September.


**Monthly Active Users (MAUs) were 1.4 million as of October 31, 2026,** **compared to 1.4 million as of September 30, 2026.**


**Payment Processing Services**
Gross transaction volume was $373.9 million for the month of October 2026, compared to $355.1 million in gross transaction volume for the month of September 2026. Gross transaction volume is calculated by converting total monthly transaction volume from British Pounds (GBP) to U.S. Dollars (USD) using the average currency conversion rate of 1 GBP to 1.34 USD for October and 1 GBP to 1.34 USD for September.


**Monthly Active Cards were** **760.6 thousand** **as of October 31, 2026, compared to** **711.2** **thousand as of September 30, 2026. Monthly Active Cards represents the total number of unique payment cards issued on behalf of enterprise customers that made transactions during the applicable month.**


**About Exodus**
Founded in 2015, Exodus Movement, Inc. (NYSE American: EXOD) is pioneering self-custodial finance by giving people the tools to earn rewards, spend, manage, and swap digital assets across borders, all without giving up control. Exodus serves millions of users through its products built on a simple principle: your money should be yours.


Exodus also powers crypto infrastructure and card/payment services for enterprise platforms serving millions of users through its enterprise product suite. Headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, Exodus is financial software where ownership is the default.
